step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify the core components from the visual graph and transcript: Developer (UserCompanyDeveloper), S3 bucket, SNS topic, Lambda function, CloudFormation, SQS queue, and EKS cluster.
2. Trace the deployment workflow: The Developer commits code and manifest file to Git/CI-CD, persisting the manifest into S3. S3 triggers an SNS notification on manifest creation. SNS fans out regional events to regional Lambda functions. Lambda reads the manifest, dynamically generates CloudFormation templates to provision regional roles/resources, and sends remaining deployment tasks to an SQS queue for fault tolerance. SQS then drives deployment execution into Amazon EKS.
